note: What a client sends to say where its view sits and which way it faces. It is sent once where a server answers it, and again and again where a server does not. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: positionX
fields.note: Where the view stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: directionX
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: directionY
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: directionZ
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id the sender holds.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The report's number, counting up as the view moves.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client the view belongs to.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Names this report, counting up as the view moves. A client sends the report again until a server returns the name.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client the view belongs to.

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: Names this report, counting up as the view moves. A client sends the report again until a server returns the name.
